title: Core admin credit-adjustment write producer with Ops real acceptance
objective: Implement the MCP-F4-CONTRACTS-002 locked alpha.10 admin credit-adjustment write face in Core (createAdminCreditAdjustment with admin:write three-credential authorization, kind/symbol validation, idempotent replay, the non-negative-balance 409 CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_CONFLICT and 201 AdminCreditLedgerEntry responses) and validate it end-to-end with the Ops real Keycloak administrator stack: contract lock upgrade to alpha.10, producer, tests, realm admin:write authorization and the validate-dev-admin.ps1 write-face acceptance scenarios.
in_scope: Core contracts lock upgrade from 0.1.0-alpha.9 to 0.1.0-alpha.10 (contracts/core-api.lock.json pointing at the b50f62a lock) with verify-contracts and the contract test suite green against the new face

Admin write producer: POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/credit-adjustments on the ADR-0018 AdminController with parameterized admin:write authorization (OIDC credential + admin:write scope + ADMIN business role, ACTIVE via principal resolution), path UUID 404 semantics, body field-closed parsing (kind grant/refund/adjustment, non-zero amount with positive grant/refund, reason 1..512 mandatory, reference_id up to 255), Idempotency-Key 8..200 mandatory with the CreditsLedgerService idempotent command semantics (same-key/same-request replay returns the original recorded response; different request 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT), ledger primitive mapping (grant/refund/adjust with callerId = administrator user id, operation naming and reason recorded verbatim), rejection mapping (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/REFUND_LIMIT/BALANCE_CEILING to the admin-face-only 409 CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_CONFLICT problem code added to the public problem catalog), 201 AdminCreditLedgerEntry response shape with no new migration

Tests: contract tests against the alpha.10 lock, HTTP e2e for the write face (success, replay, conflict, symbol rejection, insufficient balance, authorization negatives) and real-PostgreSQL integration reusing the established fixture patterns; existing admin read-face regression untouched

Ops realm: admin:write grant for the designated administrator web client plus validate-dev-admin.ps1 write-face scenarios (administrator PKCE login, grant/refund/adjustment success paths with detail and ledger read-backs, same-key replay, key conflict, negative balance 409, kind/symbol 400, missing scope 403, non-ADMIN role 403, PAT admin:write catalog rejection, unknown user 404) run twice for real acceptance

Core docs sync (STATUS/development-plan/runtime inputs unchanged by design) and Ops docs sync for the acceptance extension; final trees pass the full gate suites; ff-only main merges and pushes under the owner blanket directives
out_of_scope: Any further admin write batch (PAT/app revocation, user status changes) - later owner decisions only
SDK exposure of createAdminCreditAdjustment (a separate Contracts slice needs this producer as evidence), public credit billing surfaces, Q-003/Q-013 values
New middleware, new migrations beyond what the ledger primitives already have, changes to the alpha.9 read face
contract_impact: Core implements the already-locked Contracts 0.1.0-alpha.10 face; no contract file changes in this slice
